summary: Fridge Scanner -> INSTANT /recipe enhancement verified. BACKEND (5/5 passing, pytest_mobile_fridge.xml) POST /api/mobile-fridge/scan contract confirmed with a real fridge JPEG: returns {scan_id, ingredients[], recipes[]}; NEW assertion enforces that EVERY recipe carries a non-empty instructions[] whose entries are non-empty strings (which is what fridge.tsx openRecipe needs to build the pre-baked markdown content). Auth: missing header -> 403, bad bearer -> 401; empty image_data -> 400; invalid base64 -> 400/422/502. FRONTEND wiring code-reviewed (/app/frontend/app/fridge.tsx openRecipe lines 68-92 + /app/frontend/app/recipe.tsx line 46+55): (a) r.instructions is mapped via `s?.instruction || s?.text || s?.step || String(s)` so both plain-string and normalised {stepNumber,instruction,...} shapes are unwrapped; (b) parts array builds `## Ingredients`, `## Also grab`, `## Instructions` numbered list; (c) content is passed to /recipe ONLY when the joined markdown is non-empty (`...(content ? { content } : {})`); (d) recipe.tsx reads `providedContent = p.content` and its detailed-recipe useQuery has `enabled: !providedContent` so when content is passed there are ZERO POST /api/recipes/detailed calls; (e) regression fallback: a fridge recipe with NO instructions AND no ingredients_used AND no missing_ingredients yields empty content, so the content param is omitted -> providedContent === '' -> useQuery runs -> POST /api/recipes/detailed fires (correct fallback). UI sanity: app loads at public URL on 390x844 mobile viewport, /fridge lock screen renders (fridge-upgrade + fridge-close testIDs present), no console errors, and 0 POST /api/recipes/detailed calls observed during landing + fridge navigation. The Text-import 'View full recipe' shared /recipe path was proven end-to-end in iteration_109 (same providedContent code path — unaffected). Camera image cannot be injected via headless web per agent-to-agent context note, so the subscribed suggestion-card tap was validated by code review + backend contract test rather than a live scan.
critical_code_review_comments: fridge.tsx openRecipe correctly unwraps instructions with a defensive fallback chain (`s?.instruction || s?.text || s?.step || String(s)`) — matches import.tsx after the iteration_109 fix, so both premium quick-actions share identical mapper behaviour.

recipe.tsx `enabled: !providedContent` is the single switch that skips /api/recipes/detailed. Guard is boolean-tight: empty-string providedContent evaluates falsy, so useQuery runs, which is the intended regression fallback.
content param is only added when parts.join('\n').trim() is non-empty — this cleanly separates the instant-render path from the regression fetch path with no ambiguity.

Router params pass the full markdown via URL query; for very long AI outputs this could theoretically hit URL length limits on web. Non-blocking; consider an in-memory handoff (already flagged in iteration_109 review).

New pytest assertion in test_mobile_fridge.py ensures each returned recipe's instructions[] is a non-empty list of non-empty strings — this is the exact backend contract the instant-render path depends on.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_mobile_fridge.py (added strict per-recipe instructions[] string assertion in TestFridgeContract.test_scan_returns_ingredients_and_recipes)

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 pytest, including new non-empty instructions[] assertion)
success_rate.frontend: 3/3 review items verified: (1) openRecipe mapper+content wiring correct; (2) recipe.tsx skips /recipes/detailed when content is provided; (3) empty-instructions fallback still triggers /recipes/detailed. Import path unaffected (iter_109).

seed_data_creation: Registered fresh account fr_test+<ts>@example.com/Test1234 via /api/auth/register in pytest fixture. Uses /tmp/fridge.jpg (~180KB real Unsplash fridge photo, present) for the AI contract test; one fridge_scans document persisted per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The instant-render Fridge->Recipe path piggybacks on the same providedContent branch already proven for the Text-import 'View full recipe' flow (iter_109). To fully e2e-verify the tap path in a headless browser you would need to seed a fake ScanResult into the /fridge screen state (e.g. via a debug hook or by mocking the /api/mobile-fridge/scan response with page.route). Camera capture is not exercisable headlessly. Backend contract test in /app/backend/tests/test_mobile_fridge.py now enforces the string-shape of instructions[] — if a future AI/prompt regression starts emitting objects, that test will fail and catch it before it reaches the client mapper. Run with: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<public url> pytest backend/tests/test_mobile_fridge.py -v`. Note that conftest reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL first, falling back to EXPO_BACKEND_URL — export at least one.
rca_of_issue: N/A — enhancement verified working. openRecipe pre-bakes the markdown (Ingredients + Also grab + numbered Instructions) and passes it as the `content` param; recipe.tsx's useQuery for /api/recipes/detailed is gated by `enabled: !providedContent`, so when content is present the extra AI call is skipped and the recipe opens instantly. When content is absent (recipe has none of ingredients_used/missing_ingredients/instructions), the content param is omitted and recipe.tsx falls back to POST /api/recipes/detailed as before.
